d: An avian humanoid with a sharp, hooked beak and a regal, mature expression. The creature is adorned in a luxurious, layered ensemble of deep crimson, gold, and black, featuring a high-collared mantle and a sweeping, floor-length cloak. A crown-like crest of red and gold feathers sits atop the head, and the creature holds a tall, ornate golden staff topped with a spherical ornament. BODY COLOR: White and gold LEGS: Digitigrade with taloned feet.
